title: Lithium chloride purification of RNA from DSS-treated tissues
author: Emilie Viennois
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kk3cuyn

steps.title: First LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of lithium chloride purification to remove polysaccharides and DSS.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the RNA with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl (diluted in RNase-free water) on ice for 2 h.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 min at 4°C.
Pour out the supernatants and dissolve the RNA pellet in 200 µL of RNase-free water.

steps.title: Second LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of lithium chloride purification for further cleaning.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the RNA with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl (diluted in RNase-free water) on ice for 2 h.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 min at 4°C.
Pour out the supernatants and dissolve the RNA pellet in 200 µL of RNase-free water.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the purified RNA using sodium acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) and 2 volumes of 100% absolute ethanol to the RNA.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 min at 4°C.

steps.title: RNA Wash and Recovery
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet and resuspend in RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Pour out the supernatants and wash the pellets with 100 μL of 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatants and dissolve the RNA in 20–50 μl of RNAse-free water.
